neighbours.label: repaying borrowed money: the point where a debt or loan is to be paid back
fire: Student loans usually have to be paid back with interest after graduation.
He borrowed five hundred dollars from his brother and promised to repay it by May.
The company struggled to meet the repayment schedule on its bank loan.
A mortgage is a loan that must be repaid over twenty or thirty years.
She is still paying back the money she borrowed to start the shop.
The government will need decades to pay off its foreign debt.
If you cannot return the borrowed sum on time, the lender charges a fee.
Monthly repayments on the car loan take a large part of his salary.
quiet: Student grants usually do not have to be spent on tuition alone.
He received five hundred dollars from his brother as a birthday gift.
The company struggled to meet the delivery schedule for its new product.
A mortgage broker helps buyers compare houses in different towns.
She is still saving money to start a small shop of her own.
The government will need decades to rebuild its railway network.
If you cannot return the library book on time, the library charges a fee.
Monthly bills for electricity take a small part of his salary.
